items.title: AI assistants
items.summary: An assistant that answers your customers or your team from your own materials — at any hour.
points: Answers from your documents, prices and terms
On your website, in your store or inside the company
Hands the conversation to a person when needed
You see what customers are asking
An AI mentor for online courses and training
items.intro: Most customer questions repeat: prices, deadlines, terms, availability. The AI assistant answers them immediately, at any hour, from your own materials rather than making things up. When the question needs a person, it hands the conversation over together with everything said so far. The same approach works inside the company — an assistant that knows the rules and the documents and helps a new employee.
suitable: You answer the same questions by phone, email and chat.
Customers write outside working hours and by morning have gone elsewhere.
New team members keep asking the same things, and the answers are in the documents.
result: A working assistant on your website or in an internal system.
Knowledge loaded from your documents, easy to update.
A view of the conversations — what people ask and where the assistant did not know.
Monthly maintenance that also covers the cost of the AI model.

items.title: AI for online stores
items.summary: An assistant that knows your catalogue: it recommends products, answers about delivery and orders, and keeps the customer from leaving.
points: Recommends products based on what the customer is looking for
Answers about stock, delivery and order status
Product descriptions drafted by AI
Works with WooCommerce and with custom-built stores
items.intro: In a shop on the street the assistant asks what you are looking for and walks you to the shelf. In an online store the customer is alone — and often leaves without finding what they need. The AI assistant knows your catalogue, stock and terms, answers immediately and suggests suitable products. The same tool helps you on the inside: it writes descriptions for new products that you only approve.
suitable: You have many products and customers find it hard to choose between them.
The same questions about delivery, sizes and returns arrive every day.
Adding new products with descriptions takes you hours.
result: An assistant in the store, connected to the catalogue and stock.
Answers about orders and delivery according to your terms.
A product description tool in the admin area.
A view of the conversations — what customers look for and what they do not find.

You process many documents, enquiries or recordings by hand.
Orders from the store do not reach the warehouse and accounting on their own.
result: An automated process you can monitor and stop.
A description of how information flows and what happens on error.
The source code and documentation.
Monitoring and maintenance after launch.

items.title: AI on your own server
items.summary: Search and answers over your documents, on a server that is yours — the data never leaves the company.
points: Search by meaning across your documents
Answers with the source cited
Runs on your server or in a cloud you choose
Permissions: who can ask and see what

suitable: You have thousands of pages of documents and finding the right one takes hours.
Your data must not leave the company — by law, by contract or by your own decision.
You want AI without depending on a single external provider.
result: A working system on your server, with sign-in and permissions for staff.
Documents loaded and a way to add new ones.
A description of the infrastructure and the running costs.
Team training and maintenance after launch.

items.title: Custom-built websites
items.summary: A hand-coded website — no template and no dead weight, so it is fast, secure and ranks well on Google.
points: Design and code written for your business
Multiple languages and search optimisation from the ground up
Works on phone, tablet and desktop
Easy content updates
items.intro: Your website is the first place customers check. We code it line by line for your business instead of bending a ready-made template. It loads in a fraction of a second, has no unnecessary add-ons to be breached or go out of date, and is structured for search engines from the ground up rather than as an afterthought.
suitable: You have no website, or the current one is outdated and brings no enquiries.
You want to update texts and images yourself, without looking for a developer.
You work with customers in more than one country and need several languages.
result: A working website on your domain, checked on phone, tablet and desktop.
Access to content management and a short training on how to use it.
The source code and documentation — the website is yours.
Registration in Google Search Console and a submitted sitemap.

items.title: WordPress websites
items.summary: A quick start: a website on the most widely used platform, with a theme written for you, ready in days.
points: A custom theme, not a purchased template
Custom plugins when ready-made ones are not enough
You update the content yourself
AI features right inside WordPress
items.intro:
WordPress is the fastest route to a working website and the easiest to manage for someone who is not a developer. The difference is in the build: we write the theme for your business instead of buying a template with dozens of unnecessary add-ons, and we code our own plugins when you need something the ready-made ones do not do. That keeps the site fast and secure.

WordPress does not mean a website without artificial intelligence. We build AI right into it: an assistant that answers visitors from your content, an AI mentor for courses and training, automatic drafts of texts and descriptions in the admin area. We code them as our own plugins, so they work with your theme and do not depend on third-party subscriptions.
suitable: You are starting a business and need a good website quickly and at a sensible price.
You want to add pages, news and products yourself.
You already have a WordPress site that is slow or needs a new feature.
result: A website of up to 5 pages, ready in 7–10 working days.
A theme written for you and only the plugins you really need.
Access to the admin area and a short training session.
Room to grow: a store, a second language, an AI assistant.

process.title: How we work
process.lead: A clear process with visible results at every stage. You know what is being done, why it is being done and when it will be ready.

steps.title: Understanding the task
steps.text: We start with questions. We clarify what problem we are solving, who will use the system and how we will know the project is a success.

steps.title: Plan and architecture
steps.text: We define the scope, split the work into stages and choose the technology. You receive a plan with timelines and a price before a line of code is written.

steps.title: Staged development
steps.text: We work in short stages. After each one you see a working version and can change direction while change is still cheap.

steps.title: Testing and launch
steps.text: We test functionality, speed and security. We launch according to a plan, with a prepared way to roll back.

steps.title: Support and growth
steps.text: After launch we monitor how the system performs, fix problems and add what your business needs next.
